_note: DATA (ADR-002 §4). Every metric is `id + inputs + formula`, where the formula is a small STRUCTURAL expression tree over `{analyte}`, `{const}` and the four arithmetic ops. Adding a metric is a data edit; engine/profile.js contains no analyte name and no metric name (ADR-002 D5, grep-asserted).
_gfr_is_deliberately_absent: base/modules/01-profile.md lists GFR among its derived metrics and this table does NOT ship it. CKD-EPI needs age, sex and a piecewise term — inputs that are demographics rather than folded observations, and a shape this four-op expression tree cannot express. Shipping an approximation would be an invented clinical constant, which the house Integrity rule forbids. The honest state is: not shipped, and said so here. A future ADR may extend the expression language and add it.
